// Code generated by gocpy (Go bridge generator); DO NOT EDIT.
//
// This program runs with the user's Go toolchain inside the bridge module.
// It reads the exported API of the requested Go packages from compiler
// export data and writes bridge/bridge.go (cgo exports) and api.json.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/constant"
	"go/importer"
	"go/token"
	"go/types"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type request struct {
	Packages []string `json:"packages"`
}

type fn struct {
	Name    string   `json:"name"`
	ID      string   `json:"id"`
	Params  []string `json:"params"`
	Results []string `json:"results"`
	Error   bool     `json:"error"`
}

type cst struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Type  string `json:"type"`
	Value string `json:"value"`
}

type pkgOut struct {
	Path        string            `json:"path"`
	Name        string            `json:"name"`
	Funcs       []fn              `json:"funcs"`
	Consts      []cst             `json:"consts"`
	Unsupported map[string]string `json:"unsupported"`
}

func fail(f string, a ...any) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "gocpy go bridge: "+f+"\n", a...)
	os.Exit(1)
}

var errorType = types.Universe.Lookup("error").Type()

// gocpyType maps a Go type to its Gocpy spelling.
func gocpyType(t types.Type) (string, bool) {
	switch u := t.Underlying().(type) {
	case *types.Basic:
		switch u.Kind() {
		case types.Bool:
			return "bool", true
		case types.Int:
			return "int", true
		case types.Int8:
			return "int8", true
		case types.Int16:
			return "int16", true
		case types.Int32:
			return "int32", true
		case types.Int64:
			return "int64", true
		case types.Uint:
			return "uint", true
		case types.Uint8:
			return "uint8", true
		case types.Uint16:
			return "uint16", true
		case types.Uint32:
			return "uint32", true
		case types.Uint64:
			return "uint64", true
		case types.Uintptr:
			return "uintptr", true
		case types.Float32:
			return "float32", true
		case types.Float64:
			return "float64", true
		case types.String:
			return "string", true
		}
	case *types.Slice:
		if b, ok := u.Elem().Underlying().(*types.Basic); ok && b.Kind() == types.Uint8 {
			return "[]byte", true
		}
	}
	return "", false
}

var cTypes = map[string]string{
	"bool": "C.bool", "int": "C.int64_t", "int8": "C.int8_t", "int16": "C.int16_t", "int32": "C.int32_t",
	"int64": "C.int64_t", "uint": "C.uint64_t", "uint8": "C.uint8_t", "uint16": "C.uint16_t",
	"uint32": "C.uint32_t", "uint64": "C.uint64_t", "uintptr": "C.uintptr_t", "float32": "C.float",
	"float64": "C.double",
}

type gen struct {
	b       bytes.Buffer
	imports map[string]string // path -> alias
	n       int
}

func (g *gen) qual(p *types.Package) string {
	if a, ok := g.imports[p.Path()]; ok {
		return a
	}
	a := fmt.Sprintf("p%d", len(g.imports))
	g.imports[p.Path()] = a
	return a
}

func (g *gen) goType(t types.Type) string { return types.TypeString(t, g.qual) }

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		fail("usage: gen request.json")
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
	var req request
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &req); err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
	cmd := exec.Command("go", append([]string{"list", "-e", "-export", "-deps", "-json", "--"}, req.Packages...)...)
	cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
	out, err := cmd.Output()
	if err != nil {
		fail("go list failed: %v", err)
	}
	exports := map[string]string{}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(out))
	var errs []string
	for dec.More() {
		var p struct {
			ImportPath string
			Export     string
			Error      *struct{ Err string }
		}
		if err := dec.Decode(&p); err != nil {
			fail("go list output: %v", err)
		}
		if p.Error != nil {
			errs = append(errs, p.Error.Err)
		}
		exports[p.ImportPath] = p.Export
	}
	if len(errs) > 0 {
		fail("%s", strings.Join(errs, "\n"))
	}
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	imp := importer.ForCompiler(fset, "gc", func(path string) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
		f := exports[path]
		if f == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no export data for %s", path)
		}
		return os.Open(f)
	})

	g := &gen{imports: map[string]string{}}
	var pkgs []pkgOut
	for _, path := range req.Packages {
		pkg, err := imp.Import(path)
		if err != nil {
			fail("import %s: %v", path, err)
		}
		po := pkgOut{Path: path, Name: pkg.Name(), Unsupported: map[string]string{}}
		if pkg.Name() == "main" {
			fail("%s is a Go command (package main), not a library", path)
		}
		names := pkg.Scope().Names()
		sort.Strings(names)
		for _, name := range names {
			obj := pkg.Scope().Lookup(name)
			if !obj.Exported() {
				continue
			}
			switch obj := obj.(type) {
			case *types.Func:
				f, why := g.function(pkg, obj)
				if why != "" {
					po.Unsupported[name] = why
					continue
				}
				po.Funcs = append(po.Funcs, f)
			case *types.Const:
				c, why := constDecl(obj)
				if why != "" {
					po.Unsupported[name] = why
					continue
				}
				po.Consts = append(po.Consts, c)
			case *types.TypeName:
				po.Unsupported[name] = "Go types are not supported by the bridge yet (functions and constants only)"
			case *types.Var:
				po.Unsupported[name] = "Go package variables are not supported by the bridge yet (functions and constants only)"
			}
		}
		pkgs = append(pkgs, po)
	}

	var src bytes.Buffer
	src.WriteString("// Code generated by gocpy (Go bridge); DO NOT EDIT.\npackage main\n\n")
	src.WriteString("/*\n#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stdbool.h>\n#include <stdlib.h>\n*/\nimport \"C\"\n\n")
	src.WriteString("import (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"unsafe\"\n")
	var paths []string
	for p := range g.imports {
		paths = append(paths, p)
	}
	sort.Strings(paths)
	for _, p := range paths {
		fmt.Fprintf(&src, "\t%s %q\n", g.imports[p], p)
	}
	src.WriteString(")\n\nfunc main() {}\n\n")
	src.WriteString(`var _ = fmt.Sprint

func gocpyStr(p **C.char, n *C.int64_t, s string) {
	*n = C.int64_t(len(s))
	if len(s) == 0 {
		*p = nil
		return
	}
	m := C.malloc(C.size_t(len(s)))
	copy(unsafe.Slice((*byte)(m), len(s)), s)
	*p = (*C.char)(m)
}

func gocpyBytes(p *unsafe.Pointer, n *C.int64_t, b []byte) {
	*n = C.int64_t(len(b))
	if len(b) == 0 {
		*p = nil
		return
	}
	m := C.malloc(C.size_t(len(b)))
	copy(unsafe.Slice((*byte)(m), len(b)), b)
	*p = m
}

func gocpyPanic(p **C.char, n *C.int64_t, v any) {
	*p = C.CString(fmt.Sprint(v))
	*n = -1
}

`)
	src.Write(g.b.Bytes())
	if err := os.MkdirAll("bridge", 0o755); err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join("bridge", "bridge.go"), src.Bytes(), 0o644); err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
	js, _ := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"packages": pkgs}, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile("api.json", js, 0o644); err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
}

func (g *gen) function(pkg *types.Package, obj *types.Func) (fn, string) {
	sig := obj.Type().(*types.Signature)
	if sig.TypeParams().Len() > 0 {
		return fn{}, "generic Go functions are not supported by the bridge"
	}
	if sig.Variadic() {
		return fn{}, "variadic Go functions are not supported by the bridge yet"
	}
	f := fn{Name: obj.Name()}
	for i := 0; i < sig.Params().Len(); i++ {
		t := sig.Params().At(i).Type()
		gt, ok := gocpyType(t)
		if !ok {
			return fn{}, fmt.Sprintf("parameter %d has type %s, which the Go bridge does not support yet", i+1, t)
		}
		f.Params = append(f.Params, gt)
	}
	res := sig.Results()
	for i := 0; i < res.Len(); i++ {
		t := res.At(i).Type()
		if i == res.Len()-1 && types.Identical(t, errorType) {
			f.Error = true
			break
		}
		gt, ok := gocpyType(t)
		if !ok {
			return fn{}, fmt.Sprintf("result %d has type %s, which the Go bridge does not support yet", i+1, t)
		}
		f.Results = append(f.Results, gt)
	}
	g.n++
	f.ID = fmt.Sprintf("gocpy_gobrx_%d", g.n)

	alias := g.qual(pkg)
	var params, args []string
	for i := 0; i < sig.Params().Len(); i++ {
		t := sig.Params().At(i).Type()
		gt := f.Params[i]
		conv := g.goType(t)
		switch gt {
		case "string":
			params = append(params, fmt.Sprintf("a%dp *C.char, a%dn C.int64_t", i, i))
			args = append(args, fmt.Sprintf("%s(C.GoStringN(a%dp, C.int(a%dn)))", conv, i, i))
		case "[]byte":
			params = append(params, fmt.Sprintf("a%dp unsafe.Pointer, a%dn C.int64_t", i, i))
			args = append(args, fmt.Sprintf("%s(C.GoBytes(a%dp, C.int(a%dn)))", conv, i, i))
		default:
			params = append(params, fmt.Sprintf("a%d %s", i, cTypes[gt]))
			args = append(args, fmt.Sprintf("%s(a%d)", conv, i))
		}
	}
	var lhs []string
	var stores []string
	for i, gt := range f.Results {
		lhs = append(lhs, fmt.Sprintf("r%d", i))
		switch gt {
		case "string":
			params = append(params, fmt.Sprintf("o%dp **C.char, o%dn *C.int64_t", i, i))
			stores = append(stores, fmt.Sprintf("gocpyStr(o%dp, o%dn, string(r%d))", i, i, i))
		case "[]byte":
			params = append(params, fmt.Sprintf("o%dp *unsafe.Pointer, o%dn *C.int64_t", i, i))
			stores = append(stores, fmt.Sprintf("gocpyBytes(o%dp, o%dn, []byte(r%d))", i, i, i))
		default:
			params = append(params, fmt.Sprintf("o%d *%s", i, cTypes[gt]))
			stores = append(stores, fmt.Sprintf("*o%d = %s(r%d)", i, cTypes[gt], i))
		}
	}
	if f.Error {
		lhs = append(lhs, "err")
	}
	params = append(params, "ep **C.char, en *C.int64_t")
	b := &g.b
	fmt.Fprintf(b, "//export %s\nfunc %s(%s) (st C.int) {\n", f.ID, f.ID, strings.Join(params, ", "))
	fmt.Fprintf(b, "\tdefer func() {\n\t\tif v := recover(); v != nil {\n\t\t\tgocpyPanic(ep, en, v)\n\t\t\tst = 2\n\t\t}\n\t}()\n")
	call := fmt.Sprintf("%s.%s(%s)", alias, obj.Name(), strings.Join(args, ", "))
	if len(lhs) > 0 {
		fmt.Fprintf(b, "\t%s := %s\n", strings.Join(lhs, ", "), call)
	} else {
		fmt.Fprintf(b, "\t%s\n", call)
	}
	for _, s := range stores {
		fmt.Fprintf(b, "\t%s\n", s)
	}
	if f.Error {
		b.WriteString("\tif err != nil {\n\t\tgocpyStr(ep, en, err.Error())\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n")
	}
	b.WriteString("\treturn 0\n}\n\n")
	return f, ""
}

func constDecl(obj *types.Const) (cst, string) {
	c := cst{Name: obj.Name()}
	t := obj.Type()
	b, ok := t.Underlying().(*types.Basic)
	if !ok {
		return c, "unsupported constant type"
	}
	if b.Info()&types.IsUntyped == 0 {
		gt, ok := gocpyType(t)
		if !ok {
			return c, fmt.Sprintf("constant of type %s is not supported by the bridge", t)
		}
		c.Type = gt
	}
	v := obj.Val()
	switch v.Kind() {
	case constant.Bool:
		c.Value = strconv.FormatBool(constant.BoolVal(v))
	case constant.String:
		c.Value = strconv.Quote(constant.StringVal(v))
	case constant.Int:
		c.Value = v.ExactString()
	case constant.Float:
		f, _ := constant.Float64Val(v)
		s := strconv.FormatFloat(f, 'g', -1, 64)
		if !strings.ContainsAny(s, ".eEn") {
			s += ".0"
		}
		c.Value = s
	default:
		return c, "complex constants are not supported"
	}
	return c, ""
}
